build_spec.authority: Complete resolved typed build contract. Defined behavior is mandatory; explicitly unspecified cases remain unspecified. Frozen implementation identities do not turn incidental values in unspecified cases into requirements.

modules.behavior: Two-entry 8-bit elastic FIFO with no combinational data/valid fallthrough. At each rising clk edge, synchronous active-high rst discards all queued words and overrides all transfers. Reset must not clear state between edges. Outside reset, accept input iff in_valid && in_ready and retire output iff out_valid && out_ready, sampled BEFORE the edge. out_valid equals (occupancy != 0). in_ready equals (occupancy < 2) || out_ready, including simultaneous pop/push when full. This is an explicitly combinational ready path, not registered-ready isolation. out_data is the oldest unretired accepted input whenever out_valid is high; order, full 8-bit values and multiplicity must be preserved. While stalled, keep out_valid asserted and out_data unchanged until transfer or reset. Data when out_valid is low is unspecified. Newly accepted input into an empty queue becomes visible after that capture edge; earliest output handshake is the following edge (minimum one-cycle transaction latency), never a same-edge empty bypass. Sustain one accepted input and output every cycle when nonempty and downstream ready. No ports, parameters, extra cycles or capacity changes. For the Python scoreboard payload oracle ONLY: one step maps one accepted in_data to its eventual identical out_data; do not simulate FIFO occupancy, stalls or backpressure in that oracle. RTL still implements all cycle-level queue behavior above; the harness/testbench schedules handshakes.

When known=false, absence of a top annotation is not a failed or unverifiable criterion. Unannotated numeric latency is UNKNOWN, not zero. endmodule
